title: Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2610.17338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Acro

translated_title: 面向演化上下文的预算化KV缓存修复
translated_abstract: 语言模型代理会随着信息过时而修改其工作上下文，但删除文本并不能消除其对缓存计算的影响。后续的键值（KV）状态仍然以已删除的内容为条件，而重新计算整个保留后缀的代价可能很高。我们提出预算化KV缓存修复：通过重新计算用户选定比例的保留后缀来恢复任务性能。在相同相关性得分和token预算下比较不同的修复分配方案，我们发现刷新连贯的区域可以显著优于刷新孤立的token。这一发现启发了语义单元刷新（SUR）方法，它使用低成本的嵌入得分将预算分配给与查询相关的文本区域，无需训练或辅助的transformer前向计算。为了高效执行这些修复，一种分层打包执行器在每一层将选定的状态一起处理，同时保持完整的因果缓存访问。
tldr: 提出预算化KV缓存修复方法SUR，将重算预算分配给与查询相关的连贯语义区域而非孤立token，在无需训练的情况下高效修复删除过时上下文后KV缓存中的残留影响，以低成本恢复语言模型的任务性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes budgeted KV-cache repair with Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the recomputation budget to coherent query-relevant regions instead of isolated tokens, efficiently repairing residual KV-cache contamination from deleted context without training.
